title: Driisti Smart Vision Glasses
breadcrumb: Platforms > Driisti Smart Vision Glasses > Overview
seo_title: Driisti Smart Vision Glasses | Achala IT Solutions
meta_description: Driisti Smart Vision Glasses give visually challenged users AI-assisted scene awareness; assistive devices extend the platform to elderly care.

blocks.x: Independence technology for the visually challenged. Driisti Smart Vision Glasses read the user's surroundings aloud, obstacles, text, people and currency, so daily movement needs less help from others.

Driisti is a wearable assistive platform: glasses with cameras and onboard AI that describe the scene to the user through voice. It recognizes obstacles in the walking path, reads printed and digital text, and identifies familiar objects. The platform extends to assistive devices for elderly care.

items: The walking path described before the cane reaches it
Signage, documents and screens read aloud
Assistive hardware for fall-prone users, connected to family

blocks.x: Lightweight glasses carry the camera and processing unit; recognition runs on device where possible, with cloud assistance for heavier tasks. Audio output is immediate and localized to the user. Care-circle features let family members stay connected where the user opts in.

items: Scene descriptions without network dependence for core tasks
Guidance delivered while it is still useful
Family connection only with the user's consent
Camera data processed for the user, not stored for others

blocks.x: Accessibility programs, hospitals and rehabilitation centers, elder-care providers and individual users. Driisti is a deployable product, not a concept, it ships to users today.
Book a briefing with the Driisti team, or arrange a live demonstration for your accessibility program.
